_comment: Whole modules that nothing imports, transitively, from the app entrypoints.
An entry is a recorded debt, NOT an approval to keep the code. The gate
(orphan_modules --check) fails on any orphan NOT listed, and on any listed
module that is no longer an orphan (delete its entry when you delete/wire it).

The 3 superseded-dead database.py clones were DELETED 2026-08-10. The 3 below are built-but-UNWIRED (not dead): deleting them would destroy real functionality and hide a wiring bug. Each needs an OWNER (Simon) wire-vs-remove decision -- see docs/questions/002-unwired-modules.md. Do NOT delete until then.

2026-09-18 (final): the eight remaining tabs, the rest of the Trading tab, the node/update panel and the licence screens all landed. Every 'awaiting-react-port' entry is gone. notifications_controller was the last of them and outlived the port because the Settings tab shipped without the test-send buttons that used it; wiring those (routers/notifications.py) cleared it. The three entries left are the pre-React debts this file was opened for.

allowed.reason: Debug-mode FakeMT5Bridge (stage2 phase5/010). Fully built and test-covered (tests/services/broker/); production wiring is the 3-line _make_bridge seam in runtime.py, which is Simon-gated (sign-off + demo, local-debug-mode 020). Remove this entry the day the seam lands.
FakeMT5Bridge's deterministic tick engine -- imported only by fake_bridge.py, so it orphans together with it. Same seam, same removal condition.

Walk-forward harness to validate breakout recalibrations BEFORE they touch live trading; its docstring documents manual invocation (run_walkforward/report). Likely a dev tool, not dead. The frontend backtest page uses a different system (services.backtest).

Monte Carlo band around the backtest's single equity path -- docs/todo/backtest/020. Pure: takes a StrategyStats, returns percentiles, reaches nothing. Unwired because whether it surfaces on the Backtest page or stays a tool is the open decision in that file's section 3, and the owner has not answered it. Pinned by tests/backtest/test_resample.py. Delete this entry when the decision is made and it is wired (or removed).

Phase 1 of docs/todo/004: recomputes utils/regime.py's per-hour and per-level buckets over a live window and reports where the frozen constants and the data now disagree. Pure; the DB read is in tools/regime_drift_report.py, which is its caller and is not an app entrypoint. Unwired on purpose -- acting on what it reports is phase 2 and waits on the owner's answer to 004 section 4A, because a gate that widens can open trading hours that are shut today.
